# cravingmaker/skills

One owned collection of [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io/specification), with one capability per job and role routers that combine them.

Start with the [human handbook](handbook/README.md): install a role or a few skills, choose the right entry, and follow the work through proof and delivery.

## Start using the collection

Clone the repository and preview an installation before applying it:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/cravingmaker/skills.git
cd skills
scripts/install-skills.py --host codex --target ~/.codex/skills clear-communication
scripts/install-skills.py --host codex --target ~/.codex/skills --apply clear-communication
```

Repository tools need uv and Python 3.12 or newer. The optional `--host codex` flag records intent; source-policy validation runs in the default installer path too. Use the [getting-started guide](handbook/getting-started.md) for Claude Code settings, role installation, verification, updates, and copy versus symlink choices.

## Contribute

Read the [authoring guide](docs/authoring-guide.md), use the appropriate template, and run `./scripts/validate.sh`. The [catalog](catalog/skills.yaml) owns inventory and invocation preferences; each skill owns its required dependencies. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for merged changes and the handbook's [making-of guide](handbook/how-and-why.md) for the process and principles.

## License and security

MIT, except retained third-party material with its own license and attribution inside the affected skill. Follow the public [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/cravingmaker/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and [security policy](https://github.com/cravingmaker/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
